notes: Owned by C (ShorthandEdge). Source of truth for first-round agreed lex / policy.
Base mix is EN + ZH + JA (starting set, not a hard ceiling across A–E; B also ranks Romance/Germanic/Greek).
When conjunctions or adverbs show up, inserting English often helps readability.
Prefer shorter alphabet / cognate spellings when they align with meaning.
Concrete lex mappings live under conventions[]; policy-only items have kind=policy.
ℹ️ (information) is C family=emoji (EMOJI_SPEC / emoji-information); not E etymon.
Furniture EN table → short desk/table lexeme; canonical to=机; allowed_to includes JA/ZH and Romance/Germanic/Greek desk equivalents (mesa/Tisch/tavolo/tafel/τραπέζι). SQL/tech contexts keep table.
Ambiguity gate (C): conjunction shortenings marked ambiguity_sensitive skip when short form already collides in-text, or prefer_precision=True (CLI --prefer-precision).
lex metrics (required): token = B TesseraTalk estimate_tokens; bit = E MorphoZip utf8_bits (default) or closed_inventory_bits when inventory applies. Both views narrow registration candidates.
E MorphoZip closed-POS mappings are registered here as apply_layer=E (metrics + inventory) for the shared ledger; rewrite engine ownership stays on E. C apply_ledger_lex only applies apply_layer=C.

Skipped ambiguous (not registered as emit): in/on; fr as canonical (alias only); bare ES o; bare el/er/sie as outputs; cuz (prefer bc/∴ family); DE du as emit (FR du false friend — alias-only); we/us/our not core inventory slots.
Deferred-at-100 batch restored after zero-bit prune: brb/AFAIK/whereas plus clear C slang with utf8 bit shrink (no zero-bit re-adds).

family=abbrev (C-only): contractions (c-ill / I'll-family via apply_en_contractions; ledger_apply=false), chat acronyms (c-asap…), latin shorts (e.g./etc./vs/i.e.). Polarity: after C don't/can't, E may fold don't→! / can't→!can on C,E pipeline.

family=emoji (C-only): ML aliases → pivot (default EN; JA ok) → emoji via EMOJI_SPEC; ledger rows record pivot/pivot_lang; ledger_apply=true (two-step apply). Dual metrics; utf8 must shrink on sample. Short-form priority: math/symbol first when meaning is clear, else emoji — prefer existing inventory over inventing new math or emoji peers (check→✓ not ✅; star→★ not ⭐; cross→✕ not ❌). information→ℹ️ is C; FYI phrase is DEFAULT_MAP-first. Bare fire/idea/eyes/… utf8-flat forms may live in DEFAULT_MAP runtime extras. Cross-lang cheapest: select_cheapest_form / policy-cross-lang-cheapest (token then utf8).

family=symbol (C-only): open math/symbol shortenings not in E closed POS (≠ ∞ ± % ° ⇒ ⇔ ∝ √ × ÷ …). Prefer over emoji when meaning is clear (policy-short-form-priority). Skip E-owned ~/≒/= /≧/≦/∴/bc/∀. Dual metrics; utf8 must shrink. Cross-lang cheapest via select_cheapest_form.

family=ever (C): 5W1H concessive multiword → -ever (no matter how→however, what→whatever, which→whichever, where→wherever, when→whenever, who→whoever). Meaning gate on however: contrastive「しかし」 is out of scope — only listed multiword concessive from[]. ambiguity_sensitive on ever-however (collision / prefer_precision). whyever skipped (awkward). Cognate aliases (egal wie / no importa… / n'importe…) only when select_cheapest_form prefers the -ever and utf8 shrinks. ASAP remains preferred over 尽快 (c-asap).
breakdown (内訳): compact shared labels — POS 代/示/助/前/副/接/助動/冠/比/絵/記/名/動/…; else 連/熟/俗/文/頭/略/↓T/↓B/時/複. Long EN tags (collocation/acronym/…) rewrite to these.

ever_family.note: family=ever C lex + meaning_gate. Policy row is a registry pointer only (demoted from bespoke policy).
